newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bond spread narrowing stalls.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bond spread narrowing stalls.

text.p: Australian bonds outperformance against the U.S. appears to have stalled for now in the absence of any major data.
However, many analysts expect the narrowing trend to resume once the local market sees what is expected to be favourable news, particularly quarterly inflation and wages data at the end of October.
The Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread continued to creep wider having set a low of 104 basis points on Wednesday, its lowest level in over two years.
New Zealand's 10-year premium over Australia held steady, but could come under widening pressure as the N.Z. election nears and possibly to the benefit of Australian debt.
"We are coming up to an election in two weeks time. For a few weeks there will be quiet a lot of uncertainty," said Rory Robertson, fixed interest analyst at BT Australia.
"We are actually looking for a bit of a pull-back, but we like the New Zealand fundamentals, so we see that pullback as an opportunity to buy," he added.
